value.rationale: FAMO's central design uses log losses to balance relative progress and then deliberately adds re-normalization for practical stability. The theorem exactly separates what those two design choices preserve: task-balancing orientation remains invariant under arbitrary positive loss-unit changes, while the effective model step acquires one harmonic-mean scale factor. This explains how FAMO can remain directionally robust to improperly scaled tasks while still requiring learning-rate awareness of loss units, and supplies an exact compensation law for common scaling.
